description: A ground-level photograph depicting a steep hillside densely covered with various green bushes and scrubs under a bright, overcast sky. The vegetation appears to be characteristic of sclerophyllous scrubs, featuring hard, leathery, evergreen foliage adapted for arid or Mediterranean environments. The lower left corner of the image contains a faint copyright notice: "© European Environment Agency". This image provides a visual example for the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 3.2.3, "Sclerophyllous scrubs," which includes formations such as maquis, garrigue, and phrygana.
